title: Riftbound x K/DA Couture Collection drawing
summary: Registration Oct 27, 9 AM PT to Oct 30, 9 AM PT. First selection emails Nov 3; 24 hours to check out.
details: 4 K/DA Legends (Evelynn, Ahri, Akali, Kai'Sa), Packed Amphitheater battlefield, playmat, deck box, sleeves, 4 metal D12s, FIRESTARTER keychain. Also sold on-site at Convergence Fest.

title: K/DA Couture drawing: first selection emails
summary: Check inbox and spam for riotgames.com mail. 24 hours to buy; unclaimed slots are redrawn.

title: Summoner Skirmish I (Radiance)
summary: Window for stores to run the first Radiance Skirmish. Radiance cards join Nexus Night promo packs.
details: Reported prizes: Graves and Akali, Brash promos plus playmat. Reported Radiance Nexus Night promo pool: 25 cards in 3-card packs, chase card Lulu, Whimsical.

title: T1 Player Bundle + Worlds 2026 Edition drawings
summary: Two drawings, same window: Nov 13, 9 AM PT to Nov 16, 9 AM PT. First selection emails Nov 17; ships mid-December.
details: T1 2025 Worlds Champion Player Bundle: 5 Champion cards in T1 Worlds skin art, deck box, binder, sleeves, D12 (gold variant chance). Worlds 2026 Edition: Alt Art Yasuo Legend, 3 host-city Battlefields, deck box, foil sleeves; online copies add the Worlds Unvaulted Capsule 2026.

title: T1 + Worlds drawings: first selection emails
summary: Check inbox and spam for riotgames.com mail. 24 hours to buy; unclaimed slots are redrawn.

title: Gift of the Rift Bundle
summary: First-anniversary bundle at local game stores and retailers.
details: 16 boosters (3 each Origins, Spiritforged, Unleashed, Vendetta; 4 Radiance), 36 foil runes, Alt Art Akali promo and sleeves (English exclusive), 2000-card storage box.

title: Convergence Fest
summary: Riot's Riftbound + TFT festival with the NA Regional Championship (invite-only), side events, free play and the first Legacy previews.
details: Three-day GA passes include a commemorative Riftbound card. K/DA Couture Collection sold on-site.

title: Summoner Skirmish II (Radiance) — final Skirmish
summary: Window for stores to run the second Radiance Skirmish, the last before the program is retired. Nexus Cup and Challenge Series take over with Legacy.
details: Reported prizes: Lulu and Ahri, Confident promos plus playmat. Unused Skirmish byes can be used at any 2027 Regional (email OP@uvsgames.com at least 14 days ahead, or apply at badge pickup) or swapped 1-for-1 for an exclusive Reckoning promo by Dec 31, 2027.

title: Legacy Pre-Rift
summary: Set 6 Pre-Rift week. Legacy is a League Classic crossover: Ashe, Garen, Heimerdinger, Illaoi, Karma, Lux, Tryndamere, Vladimir and more.
details: Reported kit (distributor listing): 18 player kits plus 1 Legacy booster display for prizes; each player kit has a Pre-Rift pack (6 region variants), 2 Legends, 5 Legacy boosters and 2 prerelease-stamped promos. Pre-Rift promo cards not yet announced. Legacy also launches the new store programs: Nexus Cup (per-set store championship with Winner/Top 8 promos, winner playmat and a participation promo) and Challenge Series (select stores; Ladder Points to Top 32, winner earns a Regional token). Windows and promos not yet announced.

title: Riftbound Continental Dallas
location: Kay Bailey Hutchison Convention Center, Dallas, TX
summary: Day 1 is an open-entry qualifier; the main event starts Saturday. Tickets to be announced.

title: The Reckoning Pre-Rift
summary: Set 7 Pre-Rift week. Featured champions include Aurelion Sol, Cho'Gath, Shyvana, Vayne and Zilean.
details: Previews, kit contents and promo to be announced.
